children: Lion Copper will change its name to Lion Copper and implement a 27-for-1 share consolidation to list post-consolidated shares on the CSE under symbol LCU.
Announces name change to Lion Copper and share consolidation of 27 pre-consolidation shares for 1 post-consolidation share.
Post-consolidation shares to begin trading on the Canadian Securities Exchange under symbol LCU at market open on Sept 14, 2026, subject to CSE approval.
Consolidation reduces outstanding shares from 431,332,099 to ~15,975,263; fractional shares rounded (no cash paid).
Adjustment of exercise/conversion prices and share counts for outstanding convertible securities to reflect the consolidation.
Consolidation intended to meet Nasdaq Capital Market minimum bid price requirement as part of a Nasdaq listing application; approval not guaranteed.
